body.name: no_conditions
body.description: Returns true if no conditions are configured on the rule, else returns false.

body.name: is_active
body.description: Returns true if the rule is active, else returns false.

body.name: status
body.description: Returns the status of the rule as Active, Inactive, or Draft.

body.name: tags
body.description: Returns the list of tags applied to the rule.

body.name: created_by
body.description: Returns the ID of the user who created the rule.

body.name: updated_by
body.description: Returns the ID of the user who last modified the rule.

body.name: trigger_on_update
body.description: Returns true if a rule is configured to trigger on an update, else returns false.

body.name: run_rule_after_enrich
body.description: Returns true if the rule is configured to run after the enrichment policy, else returns false.

body.name: exclude_wl
body.description: Returns true to exclude allowed threat data from passing in the rules, else returns false.

body.name: exclude_fp
body.description: Returns true to exclude false-positive threat data from passing in the rules, else returns false.

body.name: is_follow
body.description: Returns true if the current user follows the rule, else returns false.

body.name: ctix_created
body.description: Returns the time and date when the rule was created.

body.name: ctix_modified
body.description: Returns the time and date when the rule was last modified.

body.name: all_sources_and_collections
body.description: Returns true if all sources are configured on the rule, else returns false.
